'''Fralideja''' was the last remaining settlements of [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarians]] on the [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. It was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the planet. [[Standard century/Legends|Centuries]] before the age of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], all other cities on Mustafar were destroyed by a massive eruption, nearly wiping out their civilization. Fralideja was located near the lava [[Klegger Corp Mining Facility/Legends|mining complex]] that became the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] stronghold in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].
